lines.text: The promise of entering God's rest still stands, and those who have believed enter that rest.
God rested on the sixth day, and those who formerly heard the good news did not enter.
A long time later, God spoke through David: if you hear His voice Today, do not harden your hearts.
If Moses had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day, so a Sabbath rest remains.
We must make every effort to enter that rest, and God's living word judges the heart's thoughts and intentions.
